Add soft-delete (trash/recycle bin) instead of permanent image deletion

How can I retrieve the adjustment values for edits that I've made in Google Photos?
I downloaded my collection of photos from Google Photos using Google Takeout, hoping to be able to save the adjustment values such as cropping, lightness, contrast, and color temperature. I thought they might be in the JSON sidecar files, but they are not. How can I retrieve the non-destructive edit values that I've made to my photos?
